subject: Life Skills
title: Filing Extensions Are Free
description: A quick win: understand Filing Extensions Are Free.

hook.text: Millions of people file under stress every April, not knowing a free six-month extension exists.

buildup.text: An extension gives you until October to file. It is a single-page form with no justification needed.

discovery.text: The extension is for filing, not for paying. You must still estimate and pay taxes owed by April.

twist.text: Filing an extension does not increase your audit risk. The IRS has confirmed this publicly many times.

climax.text: If you owe nothing or expect a refund, the extension is completely free with no penalty at all.

punchline.text: More time to file accurately costs zero.

quiz.question: What does a tax filing extension give you more time to do?
options: Pay your taxes owed to the government
File your return, but not pay what's owed
